estimate.damage_summary: During a swerve in a car, the laptop was thrown against the car door, cracking the screen and damaging the lower-right housing corner. The damage pattern and described impact are consistent with sudden external action to the laptop.
estimate.policy_notes: The portable-equipment peril covers impact caused by movement of a conveyance, including an evasive manoeuvre, if the peril and household contents cover are agreed in the schedule. The schedule is not supplied; the description indicates portable-electronics cover. Repair costs are limited to damage caused by the event, and portable-equipment examination costs are capped at EUR 250 including VAT per event. The expressly pre-existing lid scuff is not indemnified. If repair is uneconomic, the policy provides for an equivalent new unit less the achievable sale price of the damaged unit.

lines.rationale: The cracked screen is directly attributable to the described impact; fitting a complete display assembly is a plausible repair where replacing glass alone is not appropriate. A reasonable maximum should include the display component and fitting, without exceeding the policy's applicable repair-versus-replacement limit for the unit.

The lower-right corner and housing were damaged in the same impact, so replacement of the affected shell is a related repair. The estimate allows for a suitable replacement shell and fitting, not unrelated housing work.

lines.invoice_text: Polish of pre-existing lid scuff (surface only, does not affect operation)
lines.rationale: The scuff pre-dated the event and was not affected by the impact. Polishing it is cosmetic work on a pre-existing condition, not a repair cost under the policy; the price estimate is stated only on the assumption the line were valid.

The diagnostic was performed to establish the extent of damage and repair scope, so it is related to the insured impact and is an eligible examination cost if the portable-equipment cover gateway is met. The policy caps examination costs at EUR 250 including VAT per event; the reasonable net price for one inspection is estimated below that cap.
